meta.name: In the Land of Blood and Honey
meta.description: During the Bosnian War, Danijel, a soldier fighting for the Serbs, re-encounters Ajla, a Bosnian who's now a captive in his camp he oversees. Their once promising connection has become ambiguous as their motives have changed.
meta.slogan: Love can change what we want… war can change who we are
